changelog:
本次修复了亿个Bug，包括重发消息不覆盖的问题 优化了更新提示 并添加了新手引导

增添：
1. 全新新手引导：首屏先问身份，有备份就直接导入、没有就一步步带你配好
2. 配模型时会真的测一次连接，失败按 401/404/429 告诉你具体该改哪儿
3. 探测到的模型全部导入，并默认打开推理、工具与看图能力
4. 引导最后一步可一键开启酒馆模式，请求只留角色卡与聊天历史
5. 应用公告：支持配图、可勾选不再提示
6. 引导里能直接跳到角色卡导入、扩展管理、联网搜索、记忆与提示词设置

修复了：
1. 重新生成历史消息时不会清掉后面的内容了；顺带修掉一个会让整个对话被清空的隐患
2. 重发消息现在会正确覆盖，不再把新回复追加到会话末尾
3. 导入备份后还会被新手引导拦住；已配好模型的用户不会再看到引导
4. 删消息、切分支、重新生成被防丢保护误拦
5. 公告的「不再提示」误变成永久关闭所有公告
6. 刚配好模型就提示「快速模型未找到」——现在直接用你正在聊的那个模型生成标题
7. 公告配图加载很慢，现在走缓存、并发拉取、并把超时压到 3 秒
8. 提供商列表里的推广中转站全部移除，换成各家官方服务并标清门槛
9. 助手气泡默认开启、不透明度 90%；界面文案「世界书」改为「世界书与预设」

────────────

This release fixes a huge number of bugs, including regenerated messages not replacing the old ones, improves update notifications, and adds an onboarding guide.

Added:
1. New onboarding: the first screen asks your situation, then either restores a backup or walks you through setup
2. Model setup runs a real connection test and explains 401/404/429 failures in plain terms
3. Every discovered model is imported, with reasoning, tools, and image input enabled by default
4. One-tap tavern mode on the last step, which keeps the request to the character card and chat history only
5. In-app announcements with an image and a do-not-show-again checkbox
6. Onboarding can jump straight to card import, extensions, web search, and memory/prompt settings

Fixed:
1. Regenerating from a historical message no longer truncates what follows; also fixed a latent case that could wipe the whole conversation
2. Regenerated messages now correctly replace the old ones instead of being appended to the end
3. Onboarding reappeared after restoring a backup; users with a working model no longer see it at all
4. Deleting messages, switching branches, and regenerating were wrongly blocked by the data-loss guard
5. Dismissing one announcement wrongly silenced all future announcements
6. A fresh setup could immediately show a missing-fast-model error; title generation now falls back to the model you are chatting with
7. Announcement images loaded slowly; they are now cached, fetched in parallel, with a 3-second timeout
8. All promoted relay providers were removed from the provider list in favour of official services with entry requirements labelled
9. Assistant bubbles are on by default at 90% opacity; the label World Book is now World Book & Presets
